title: Public React Tic Tac Toe · keyboard play
task: Play Tic Tac Toe using only the keyboard as well as with the pointer. Preserve the visible 3-by-3 board, alternating X/O turns, occupied-cell protection, winning-player status, win/draw scoreboard, and Rematch behavior. Repair the observed inability to reach and activate board cells with the keyboard without removing pointer play or changing game rules.
